sources.title: Paul Tudor Jones: biographical opening
sources.findings: Born 28 September 1954 in Memphis; American financier; 1976 economics degree, 1980 Tudor, 1988 Robin Hood.
sources.caution: Exact birth date is secondary-source only. Infobox CEO is not used; current specialist biographies call him co-chairman and CIO. Personal wealth estimates excluded.

sources.title: About Tudor
sources.findings: Founded in 1980 by Paul Tudor Jones II; now multiple managers and discretionary/quantitative strategies across asset classes.
sources.caution: Group-wide strategy range is not a claim that Jones personally manages all portfolios; objectives are not guaranteed returns.

sources.title: Paul Tudor Jones board biography
sources.findings: Tudor founder, co-chairman and CIO; discretionary macro portfolio manager; UVA BA Economics 1976, Glasgow honorary doctorate 2014. NY Cotton Exchange chair August 1992–June 1995.
sources.caution: Honorary doctorate is not earned PhD. Advisory memberships are not government executive offices; fund assets are not personal assets.

sources.title: Robin Hood Foundation: origins
sources.findings: Founded 1988 by Jones with Peter Borish and Glenn Dubin; anti-poverty institution.
sources.caution: Secondary chronology; institutional founding is corroborated by university and JUST biographies. Do not confuse the charity with Robinhood brokerage; no proven poverty-eradication claim.

sources.title: Contemplative Sciences Center
sources.findings: Paul and Sonia Jones gift of USD12 million established center in 2012.
sources.caution: Center founding differs from later Contemplative Commons building. Donor support is not scientific proof of clinical or educational efficacy.

sources.title: October 2018 report: About JUST Capital
sources.findings: Final page states co-founded 2013 by Jones, Deepak Chopra, Rinaldo Brutoco, Arianna Huffington, Paul Scialla and others; company behavior research.
sources.caution: Read organization section, not full investment analysis. Rankings/methods are organization-specific, not objective certification or guaranteed alpha.

sources.title: Squawk Pod, 13 October 2026
sources.findings: Episode identifies Jones as guest; publisher summary describes market outlook and anticipated 2027 difficulties.
sources.caution: Metadata/description read, 45-minute audio not heard. Publication date is not independently verified recording date. Forecasts remain attributed; third-party AI transcripts excluded.

sources.title: Contemplative Sciences Center advisory-board profile
sources.findings: Founder/co-chairman/CIO, discretionary macro trading; NY Cotton Exchange chair August 1992–June 1995.
sources.caution: Undated profile; historical Robin Hood chairman wording not adopted as current role. Current board/other offices may require refresh.
